soru: Konuşma ve bağlamdan beden ve yüz hareketi üretimi için kullanılan veri kümeleri, değerlendirme ölçütleri ve üretken yöntemler üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?
istem:
Research question: Konuşma ve bağlamdan beden ve yüz hareketi üretimi için kullanılan veri kümeleri, değerlendirme ölçütleri ve üretken yöntemler üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?

Cutoff date: 2025-11-09. Only works published BEFORE this date count.

List the 30 most important works (papers) for this research question that were published before the cutoff date, in order of importance (most important first) — the kind a careful expert survey published right after the cutoff would cite. Give each with its arXiv id and/or DOI.

You MUST research this with web search rather than answer from memory: search for the important works, and verify each listed work's title, publication date and identifier on the web (e.g. arxiv.org, doi.org, the publisher or DBLP page) before including it.

When you are done, reply with ONLY a JSON object in this form (no other text):
{"calismalar": [{"sira": 1, "baslik": "exact title", "yil": 2020, "arxiv_id": "arXiv id or null", "doi": "DOI or null", "gerekce": "one sentence on why this work is important"}]}
with exactly 30 items. If you do not know an identifier, use null instead of guessing.

calismalar.baslik: A Comprehensive Review of Data-Driven Co-Speech Gesture Generation
calismalar.gerekce: This review is the field's main reference survey: it organizes datasets, generative methods and evaluation practice for co-speech gesture generation and names the open problems.

calismalar.baslik: Learning Individual Styles of Conversational Gesture
calismalar.gerekce: It introduced large-scale learning of speaker-specific gestures from in-the-wild video, and its Speech2Gesture dataset became a standard benchmark.

calismalar.baslik: Speech Gesture Generation from the Trimodal Context of Text, Audio, and Speaker Identity
calismalar.gerekce: It established trimodal conditioning on text, audio and speaker identity, and introduced the Fréchet Gesture Distance (FGD), which became the field's standard objective metric.

calismalar.baslik: BEAT: A Large-Scale Semantic and Emotional Multi-Modal Dataset for Conversational Gestures Synthesis
calismalar.gerekce: It released a 76-hour multimodal motion-capture dataset with emotion and semantic annotations, along with the CaMN baseline and the SRGR metric.

calismalar.baslik: EMAGE: Towards Unified Holistic Co-Speech Gesture Generation via Expressive Masked Audio Gesture Modeling
calismalar.gerekce: It introduced the BEAT2 (SMPL-X + FLAME) dataset and a masked-modeling method that generates face, body, hands and global motion together, now a common holistic benchmark.

calismalar.baslik: Listen, Denoise, Action! Audio-Driven Motion Synthesis with Diffusion Models
calismalar.gerekce: It was a pioneering application of diffusion models to gesture and dance synthesis, with style control through classifier-free guidance.

calismalar.baslik: Evaluating gesture generation in a large-scale open challenge: The GENEA Challenge 2022
calismalar.gerekce: Its large-scale crowdsourced evaluation showed that objective metrics correlate poorly with human judgments, a central finding on evaluation.

calismalar.baslik: Generating Holistic 3D Human Motion from Speech
calismalar.gerekce: TalkSHOW introduced the SHOW dataset and a VQ-VAE-based approach for generating holistic 3D face, body and hand motion from speech.

calismalar.baslik: Style-Controllable Speech-Driven Gesture Synthesis Using Normalising Flows
calismalar.gerekce: It brought probabilistic generative modeling (MoGlow) and style control to gesture synthesis.

calismalar.baslik: A large, crowdsourced evaluation of gesture generation systems on common data: The GENEA Challenge 2020
calismalar.gerekce: It was the first benchmark to compare gesture systems with common data and a shared subjective-evaluation protocol.

calismalar.baslik: The GENEA Challenge 2023: A large-scale evaluation of gesture generation models in monadic and dyadic settings
calismalar.gerekce: It extended evaluation to dyadic settings that take the interlocutor's behaviour into account, and added an interlocutor-appropriateness criterion.

calismalar.baslik: GestureDiffuCLIP: Gesture Diffusion Model with CLIP Latents
calismalar.gerekce: It brought multimodal style control (text, motion, video) and semantic alignment to latent gesture diffusion through CLIP.

calismalar.baslik: Taming Diffusion Models for Audio-Driven Co-Speech Gesture Generation
calismalar.gerekce: DiffGesture was one of the first diffusion frameworks for co-speech gestures, targeting the mode collapse and instability problems of GANs.

calismalar.baslik: Rhythmic Gesticulator: Rhythm-Aware Co-Speech Gesture Synthesis with Hierarchical Neural Embeddings
calismalar.gerekce: It addressed rhythm–semantics alignment with rhythm-based segmentation and hierarchical embeddings, and won a best paper award at SIGGRAPH Asia 2022.

calismalar.baslik: Talking With Hands 16.2M: A Large-Scale Dataset of Synchronized Body-Finger Motion and Audio for Conversational Motion Analysis and Synthesis
calismalar.gerekce: This roughly 50-hour dyadic motion-capture dataset with finger motion became the basis of the GENEA 2022/2023 challenges.

calismalar.baslik: Gesticulator: A framework for semantically-aware speech-driven gesture generation
calismalar.gerekce: It combined acoustic and semantic (text) features to generate both beat and semantic gestures.

calismalar.baslik: Robots Learn Social Skills: End-to-End Learning of Co-Speech Gesture Generation for Humanoid Robots
calismalar.gerekce: It introduced the TED Gesture dataset and was an early end-to-end text-to-gesture model for robots.

calismalar.baslik: Learning Hierarchical Cross-Modal Association for Co-Speech Gesture Generation
calismalar.gerekce: HA2G modeled the hierarchical correspondence between audio and gesture and set a strong baseline on TED datasets.

calismalar.baslik: From Audio to Photoreal Embodiment: Synthesizing Humans in Conversations
calismalar.gerekce: It combined VQ and diffusion for dyadic conversational motion on photorealistic avatars, and showed that the rendering method affects evaluation.

calismalar.baslik: ZeroEGGS: Zero-shot Example-based Gesture Generation from Speech
calismalar.gerekce: It enabled zero-shot style transfer from short example clips and released a dataset covering 19 styles.

calismalar.baslik: DiffuseStyleGesture: Stylized Audio-Driven Co-Speech Gesture Generation with Diffusion Models
calismalar.gerekce: It is a widely used diffusion baseline for stylized, diverse gestures from speech of arbitrary length.

calismalar.baslik: Audio2Gestures: Generating Diverse Gestures from Speech Audio with Conditional Variational Autoencoders
calismalar.gerekce: It treated the one-to-many nature of speech-to-gesture mapping explicitly with a CVAE that splits shared and motion-specific latent codes.

calismalar.baslik: Learning to Listen: Modeling Non-Deterministic Dyadic Facial Motion
calismalar.gerekce: It opened up the dyadic-interaction problem with probabilistic listener facial-motion generation and an in-the-wild dyadic dataset.

calismalar.baslik: Seamless Interaction: Dyadic Audiovisual Motion Modeling and Large-Scale Dataset
calismalar.gerekce: It released more than 4,000 hours of face-to-face conversation data with dyadic face and gesture generation models, shifting the field's data scale.

calismalar.baslik: FaceFormer: Speech-Driven 3D Facial Animation with Transformers
calismalar.gerekce: It set the standard transformer and self-supervised speech-representation approach for speech-driven 3D facial animation.

calismalar.baslik: Capture, Learning, and Synthesis of 3D Speaking Styles
calismalar.gerekce: VOCA and its VOCASET dataset form the foundational benchmark for speech-driven 3D facial animation.

calismalar.baslik: CodeTalker: Speech-Driven 3D Facial Animation with Discrete Motion Prior
calismalar.gerekce: It brought a discrete codebook motion prior to facial animation, reducing over-smoothing.

calismalar.baslik: Semantic Gesticulator: Semantics-Aware Co-Speech Gesture Synthesis
calismalar.gerekce: It addressed the open problem of semantic gesture appropriateness with LLM-based retrieval and a semantic alignment mechanism.

calismalar.baslik: ConvoFusion: Multi-Modal Conversational Diffusion for Co-Speech Gesture Synthesis
calismalar.gerekce: It provided modality-level control in latent diffusion and released the DnD multi-party group gesture dataset.

calismalar.baslik: GestureLSM: Latent Shortcut based Co-Speech Gesture Generation with Spatial-Temporal Modeling
calismalar.gerekce: It addressed the open problem of real-time inference with flow matching and latent shortcuts, giving state-of-the-art quality on BEAT2 with fast generation.
